request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere: clothing, signs and objects are plain. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep every person, whole, inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

The camera has a clear, unobstructed view from a few steps away at eye level: nothing stands between the camera and the people, every face is fully visible and in sharp focus, and everyone is seen from head to knees or lower.

They are grown-up brothers and sisters, NOT parents and children: they stand side by side as equals, close together, with their arms around each other's shoulders, all turned toward the camera and smiling warmly. They clearly look like one family: the same warm skin tone and similar dark eyes and eyebrows. No one else is in the photo.

The setting is the sunny back garden of a family house in warm late-afternoon light: a green lawn, a low white wooden fence, terracotta pots of red geraniums and a leafy tree, all softly out of focus behind the people.

Image 1 shows Ana (in the middle, sage-green overshirt) with her two sisters in the back garden. Keep Ana and her OLDER sister, the woman on the left in the teal blouse with grey strands in her hair, exactly: their faces, hair, ages and clothes, and the same garden and light. Create a new photograph a moment later with only these two: the older sister stands on the LEFT and Ana on the RIGHT, side by side. The younger sister in the coral-pink T-shirt is not in the photo. The older sister still looks clearly older than Ana.
